column.name: session_start_time
column.valueComputed: CASE WHEN court_session = 'AM' THEN (session_start || ' 10:00:00')::timestamp WHEN court_session = 'PM' THEN (session_start || ' 14:00:00')::timestamp WHEN court_session = 'AD' THEN (session_start || ' 00:01:00')::timestamp ELSE NULL END

column.name: session_end_time
column.valueComputed: CASE WHEN court_session = 'AM' THEN (session_start || ' 13:00:00')::timestamp WHEN court_session = 'PM' THEN (session_start || ' 18:00:00')::timestamp WHEN court_session = 'AD' THEN (session_start || ' 23:59:00')::timestamp ELSE NULL END
